title: skills.sh skill front matter
description: The front matter of the bundled skills.sh-compatible skill. A compatible coding agent installs and reads the skill unmodified; Tinman loads the same file to answer help questions, and the acronym generator reads its name and description. Referenced by features/bundled-skill.feature.

description.description: One line stating what the skill covers and when to use it. The acronym generator reads this field together with the name.
